name: profile_id
description: Unique company-year profile identifier ({TICKER}_{FY}, e.g., NVDA_2026)

name: ticker
description: Canonical SEC EDGAR company ticker symbol

name: cik
description: 10-digit zero-padded SEC Central Index Key

name: company_name
description: Official SEC registrant name

name: gics_sector
description: GICS Sector classification (e.g., Information Technology, Financials)

name: gics_sub_industry
description: GICS Sub-Industry classification

name: form_type
description: SEC filing form type (10-K)

name: fiscal_year
description: Reporting fiscal year resolved from XBRL dei:DocumentFiscalYearFocus

name: fiscal_period
description: Fiscal period focus (FY)

name: period_of_report
description: Fiscal period end date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: filing_date
description: SEC EDGAR filing submission date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: accession_number
description: SEC EDGAR accession number (e.g., 0001045810-26-000021)

name: currency
description: Reporting currency ISO code (USD)

name: revenue
description: Total annual revenue in raw currency units (USD)

name: operating_income
description: Annual operating income (or pre-tax continuing operations income for single-step filers) in USD

name: net_income
description: Annual net income attributable to parent in USD

name: metric_provenance
description: XBRL concept provenance for Revenue, Operating Income, and Net Income

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: XBRL concept or extractor source for revenue

fields.name: operating_income
fields.description: XBRL concept or extractor source for operating_income

fields.name: net_income
fields.description: XBRL concept or extractor source for net_income

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Accounting notes (e.g., single-step pre-tax proxy notes)

name: extracted_sections
description: 10-K sections extracted in the paired Markdown document (item_1a, item_7)

name: unstructured_blob_path
description: Relative GCS object path to unstructured 10-K Markdown

name: structured_blob_path
description: Relative GCS object path to structured financials JSON

name: unstructured_gcs_uri
description: Full gs:// URI for the paired unstructured 10-K Markdown file

name: structured_gcs_uri
description: Full gs:// URI for the paired structured financials JSON file

name: sec_filing_url
description: Direct public SEC EDGAR archive URL for source citation linking

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp when the Data Profile was generated
